feed.title: Microsoft sounds alarm as perfect-10 Entra ID flaw comes under attack
feed.summary: Microsoft has issued an alert regarding a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-69836) in its Entra ID cloud identity service, which has a maximum CVSS score of 10.0 and was already being exploited. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely due to unsafe deserialization. Although Microsoft has mitigated the vulnerability, the company has not released details about the attackers, the extent of the exploitation, or the nature of their activities.
